note: DRAFT for feature-set version 2.2. The 61 entries present before this draft are UNCHANGED and remain exactly as previously reviewed. The 39 new entries (30 pre-existing gap columns already present in 1.4/2.1 but never covered, 5 columns new in 2.1, 4 columns new in 2.2) are drafted from metadata_2.2.json's own descriptions/LOINC codes and unit hints -- NOT derived from any site's observed patient data. Each new entry's 'basis' names the reasoning. Whole-file reviewed=false until a human signs off on the 39 new entries (the previously-reviewed 61 do not need re-review). Refined 2026-09-11 after real-VM testing on 2.2 surfaced training values outside the declared domain for several columns: 6 entries (ecg_qrs_axis_first/last, smoking_duration, creatBS, valideGFR_first/last) were widened for genuine clinical/measurement-convention reasons unrelated to any specific observed value. Entries whose violations trace to physically-impossible readings (height, diastolicBp, potassium, sodium, lvef, bmi) or unexplained anomalies pending investigation (the three rehospitalization-count columns) were deliberately left unchanged -- use --clip-to-domain to handle those instead of stretching declared domains to cover impossible values. Installed as the working declaration for the 2.2 campaign; coverage verified against AUMC's 2.2 modelled numeric columns (97/97 covered).
